blocks.content: There shall be constituted in every Metropolitan area a Metropolitan Planning Committee to prepare a draft development plan for the Metropolitan area as a whole.

rows: Elected members of District Panchayat & Municipalities
Elected members of Municipalities & Panchayats Chairpersons

items: Distinguish between DPC (Article 243ZD) and MPC (Article 243ZE): DPC requires at least 4/5th elected members, whereas MPC requires at least 2/3rd elected members.
The representation of elected members in the MPC is proportional to the ratio between the population of the Municipalities and of the Panchayats in that metropolitan area.
Questions frequently test the minimum population criteria for defining a Metropolitan area (10 Lakhs or 1 Million).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 243ZE of the Constitution mandates the constitution of a Metropolitan Planning Committee (MPC) in every metropolitan area.
A metropolitan area refers to an area having a population of 10 lakh (1 million) or more, comprised in one or more districts and consisting of two or more Municipalities or Panchayats.
Not less than two-thirds of the members of the committee must be elected by and from amongst the elected members of the Municipalities and Chairpersons of the Panchayats in the Metropolitan area.
The main function of the MPC is to prepare a draft development plan for the metropolitan area as a whole.
The Chairperson of every Metropolitan Planning Committee forwards the development plan recommended by such committee to the Government of the State.
